about: Chart data for the README. Versions, their descriptions and run IDs are curated; run results and pace come from the private run logs via `npm run sts2:progress -- --refresh`.
game: Slay the Spire 2, Ironclad, Ascension 0, standard runs (no run modifiers)

versions.name: Jev v1
versions.added: One compact question per screen, no call for forced moves, reviews on risky end turns

versions.name: Jev v2
versions.added: Route and resource facts from code: elites, rests, shops, heal, potions and gold ahead

versions.name: Jev v3
versions.added: Ordered route facts; second looks at hallway potion use and leaving a shop with gold

versions.name: Strategist v2
versions.added: Claude writes the run plan at key moments; map moves follow its chosen act route

versions.name: Strategist v2.1
versions.added: Enforced combat rules: no fatal play if one survives, potion HP floor, focus target

versions.name: Strategist v3
versions.added: Claude picks rewards, shop buys, events and rest sites; fight plans saved per encounter

versions.name: Strategist v3.1
versions.added: Forecasts for exhaust and finishing cards like Fiend Fire; forecast wins are taken

versions.name: Strategist v3.2
versions.added: No ending a turn with a playable Beckon; least HP loss while enemies are Intangible

versions.name: Strategist v3.3
versions.added: Moves wait for the game's ready signal instead of fixed delays (about 4x faster)

versions.name: Strategist v3.4
versions.added: Briefs add enemy patterns, past card picks and fight results; potions saved for bosses

versions.name: Strategist v3.5
versions.added: A second look when Jev's line loses far more HP than the best surviving line

notes: Beating the final boss on floor 48 wins the run. Strategist runs use fixed seeds (JEV1 to JEV5) so versions can be compared on the same maps; v3.1 to v3.3 replayed v3's non-combat choices on JEV1, so only their combat play differed.
The imported Jev the Spire policy reached the Act 3 boss once, in a Hextech Mayhem run. That modifier changes the game, so the run is not plotted. Runs still in progress are not plotted.

pace.about: Median seconds between consecutive executed moves, including the Jev call. Gaps over 10 minutes (pauses) are left out.

groups.detail: its multi-question policy and fixed waits

groups.detail: 1.2 s after each move, 0.7 s settle, 0.6 s loop

groups.detail: acts as soon as the bridge reports the game is ready
